presentation.summary: Fetch release metadata and cover art from a self-hosted JAVBeacon instance.
presentation.description_markdown: Provides title, actresses, studio, label, tags, release date, and cover/screenshot artwork for releases tracked by [JAVBeacon](https://github.com/Net005/JAVBeacon), a self-hosted JAV release monitor/downloader. Intended as the metadata provider for a JAV-focused Movies library - each JAVBeacon release is served to Silo as a single movie item, matched by JAVBeacon's own release ID (no search-by-title matching is required once a library item is linked).
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install the plugin.
2. Add a **JAVBeacon Connection** under this plugin's configuration: your JAVBeacon instance's base URL (e.g. `https://jav.example.com`) and an API key from JAVBeacon's Settings page.
3. Add **JAVBeacon** as a metadata provider for the library you use for your JAV collection.

This plugin does not resize or transform artwork beyond what JAVBeacon itself already serves: posters use JAVBeacon's `/covers/{id}/silo-primary` endpoint (a portrait-cropped version of the source cover, already normalized because most scraped JAV covers are wide DVD-case scans rather than true portrait posters), and every other requested image size falls back to that same URL - JAVBeacon does not currently generate multiple resolutions to choose from.

capabilities.description: Release metadata from a self-hosted JAVBeacon instance.
Resolves javbeacon:// image paths to a self-hosted JAVBeacon instance.
Reports playback progress and completion back to your self-hosted JAVBeacon instance, which forwards it on to StashApp (play count, O count, resume position).
Reconcile ordered Silo collections for the StashApp Watchlist, selected Stash scene saved filters, and selected JAVBeacon Release Library saved filters.
Match local Silo items that are unmatched or ambiguous against exact JAVBeacon release codes or Stash scenes.
Check recent and older already-matched Silo items for missing cast and reapply only verified same-scene JAVBeacon or Stash metadata.
Submit and verify Silo refresh jobs for releases and Stash scenes changed since the last acknowledged source update.
Apply Stash playback history to local Silo items across movie libraries.

global_config_schema.title: JAVBeacon Connection
global_config_schema.description: Where to reach your JAVBeacon instance and how to authenticate to it.

fields.label: JAVBeacon URL
fields.description: The base URL of your JAVBeacon instance, e.g. https://jav.example.com

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: From JAVBeacon Settings. Required for a working connection; leave blank to retain a saved key.

global_config_schema.title: Silo Collection Sync
global_config_schema.description: Choose which saved filter sets become Silo collections and configure their names.

fields.label: Silo URL
fields.description: This Silo server URL, e.g. https://silo.example.com. Scheduled tasks use it directly to avoid a host callback timeout.

fields.label: Silo library ID
fields.description: Legacy/default library for targeted metadata refresh. Collection sync discovers every enabled movie library with JAVBeacon selected as a metadata provider.

fields.label: Silo API Key
fields.description: An API key for this Silo server (Admin → Users → API Keys), used to manage collections and auto-match unmatched items.

fields.label: JAVBeacon saved filters to import
fields.description: Comma-separated exact names or numeric IDs of JAVBeacon Release Library saved filters. Blank imports all JAVBeacon saved filters. This setting does not select Stash filters.

fields.label: JAVBeacon collection prefix
fields.description: Prefix added only to collections imported from JAVBeacon Release Library saved filters.

fields.label: Stash scene saved filters to import
fields.description: Comma-separated exact names or numeric IDs of StashApp SCENES saved filters. Blank disables Stash saved-filter import. Watchlist still syncs.

fields.label: Stash collection prefix
fields.description: Prefix added only to collections imported from StashApp scene saved filters. Watchlist keeps its name.
